Frequently asked questions

How many Cloud Engineer jobs are open in the United States?

Fortune Jobs AI lists 685 open Cloud Engineer jobs in the United States as of November 24, 2026.

How much do Cloud Engineer jobs in the United States pay?

The 25th–75th percentile of listed salary midpoints is $131,000–$179,000 a year, based on 137 listings where employers list pay. Listings without usable pay data are excluded; hourly and yearly pay are not mixed.

Which employers are hiring for Cloud Engineer jobs in the United States?

Employers in this catalogue include PwC (97 listings), Maximus (70 listings), Eliassen Group (33 listings), Cardinal Health (30 listings), and EY (21 listings).

55 listings mention entry-level, new-grad, junior or graduate roles in the title or description. Review the original posting for its experience requirements.
